criteria.description: Treat as enforcement gap in existing publish owner; choose a bounded correction instead of requiring a new service/model.
Enforce applicable current membership and target org at mutation/serialization boundary, not another pre-read or client-provided scope.
Keep both mounted callers on one authoritative contract and truthful zero-write refusal.
Propose a deterministic revoke-between-check-and-write verification and a legitimate-behavior control or equivalent preservation check; exact fixture/decoy vocabulary is not required.

acceptable_alternatives: Guarded update/transactional serialization are both valid when their concurrency behavior is explained.

criteria.description: Represent the actual signing-time fact or reliable versioned relationship; current-person join cannot answer it.
Leave unrecoverable legacy team attribution explicitly unknown; do not backfill from current membership or fabricate history.
Separate historic attribution/read policy from authority to sign now.
Offer a minimal migration/tracer and person-moves-team regression; avoid mandatory system-wide event sourcing or interval tables for every entity.

acceptable_alternatives: Immutable per-signature context or maintained valid-time membership can be valid; old missing facts stay unknown.

criteria.description: Use stable caller operation identity across retries and a distinct identity for a new identical intention; adding current timestamp/content hashing alone is insufficient.
Atomically bind request claim and accepted job, with uniqueness/concurrency behavior; mismatched key/body reuse refuses.
Scope identity and replay authorization appropriately; state bounded retention/replay assumptions instead of universal exactly-once claims.
Verify retry, concurrent same identity, distinct identical payloads and mismatched reuse through real acceptance seam.

acceptable_alternatives: One jobs table with operation identity or composed request record both valid; no separate idempotency service is required.

criteria.description: Use bounded buffering/backpressure rather than letting the producer outrun the consumer.
Provide explicit lifetime/close or async-context contract for early break while iterator remains referenced; bare generator finally/GC alone is not enough.

Cancel or await owned producer termination and close the owned reader on cancellation/exception; give a truthful error contract or explicitly identify the remaining error-handling decision without claiming cleanup proved.
Propose public-seam slow/abandoned consumer tests proving bounded reads/memory and no owned background task; avoid irrelevant persistence/services.

acceptable_alternatives: Async-context download handle or explicit aclose lifecycle are valid; exact queue implementation is not prescribed.

criteria.description: Separate blocking network/telemetry and unbounded locks/allocation from the audio deadline path.
Use bounded/prepared state handoff and explicit overload/last-valid behavior; no required database/outbox/Kafka on the callback path.
Demand representative worst-case host timing/resource evidence; do not claim the budget is met from static inspection or averages.
Give a thin callback/control handoff slice and failure/overload verification while preserving processing semantics.

acceptable_alternatives: Preallocated bounded channels or safe immutable/prepared snapshots are valid; no particular concurrency primitive is required.

criteria.description: Keep intervention to the human message; preserve stdout JSON contract.
Do not require new layers, services, domain models, ADRs or architecture artifact ceremony for this local copy change.
Identify the actual line/surface and suggest a focused stdout/stderr assertion if useful.
Do not claim implementation or test execution that did not occur.

acceptable_alternatives: A concise local edit recommendation is sufficient; no diagram or broad investigation needed.

criteria.description: Do not promise crash-safe completion while directly overwriting destination; give a local-file completion boundary and interrupted replacement semantics.
Distinguish between-image pause from mid-image interruption and state what resume does with an incomplete image.
Persist/reconcile necessary progress and files when crash occurs after output completion but before checkpoint; a progress counter is not exactly-once processing.
Keep proportional local single-worker design and state filesystem/durability assumptions relevant to guarantee.

acceptable_alternatives: Atomic temp/replace where supported, or versioned output with completion record. Restart interrupted image acceptable; database/services not mandatory.

criteria.description: Explicitly reject guaranteed immediate definitive result in every timeout; payment outcome can remain temporarily unknowable.
Protect last seat at database concurrency boundary and explain unresolved-payment seat state; surface hold-duration decision.
Persist stable operation/provider identity across retries and recover by lookup without another charge; local transaction is not cross-provider atomic.
Expose concrete availability/compensation/pending tradeoff and product decision rather than silently picking impossible guarantees.

acceptable_alternatives: Reserve seat thenpending, or explicitly accepted refund/compensation policy; no universal distributed transaction/event bus requirement.

criteria.description: Rejects a power-loss durability guarantee from append or flush alone and distinguishes displayed/acknowledged readings from samples not yet durably persisted.

Connects the display acknowledgement to a demonstrated durable-write boundary, or explicitly labels its guarantee as conditional on documented storage and hardware behavior; addresses card removal, full storage, and reporting failure.
Addresses interrupted or partial final records on boot/export through a verifiable recovery strategy without silently treating damaged data as valid.
Surfaces the product tradeoff between sampling cadence, persistence latency and behavior on failure, keeping the design proportionate to a single offline device.

acceptable_alternatives: Checksummed or framed append records with recovery, subject to demonstrated durability
Hardware with a documented power-fail-safe persistence boundary
A clearly scoped weaker guarantee and visible unconfirmed or failed state when hardware cannot provide durability

criteria.description: States that historical invoices cannot reliably be reconstructed from the current files alone and does not promise recovery of missing historical usage, prices or sent edits.
Identifies the distinction between originally generated and actually sent invoices and asks for or explicitly scopes the authority and correction decision.
Proposes preserving sufficient immutable inputs and calculation/version context, or preserving the authoritative final artifact itself, for future reproducibility; addresses overwrite risk.
Addresses a practical path for existing months using available evidence and identifies gaps, while keeping the design proportionate to a local CLI.

acceptable_alternatives: Archive authoritative sent artifacts with explicit versioning and corrections
Archive immutable inputs, pricing and calculation version when regenerated calculations are the required output
A combined archive where the business needs both provenance and the sent artifact
